pleaseInputEmail: Please input a valid work email!
pleaseInputValidPhoneNumber: Please input a valid phone number!
descriptionMaxLength: About me must not exceed 1000 characters
fullNameMaxLength: Full name must be less than 255 characters
fullNameInvalidFormat: Full name must contain only letters and single spaces between words

signature.intro: Used to "Sign & approve" request documents at steps that require a signature. You set a PIN (6–12 digits) to unlock signing each time; the system does not store your PIN. An administrator must approve your registration before you can sign.
signature.pinHint: 6–12 digits. Avoid birthdays and phone numbers.
signature.drawHint: Sign in the box with a mouse or stylus.
signature.optionalHint: Optional — without an image the signature box shows only your name and the time.
signature.uploadHint: Drop or click to choose a PNG/JPEG image (a transparent PNG looks best)
signature.imageInvalid: Only PNG/JPEG images up to 5MB are accepted
signature.pendingHint: You can sign once an administrator issues your certificate.
signature.cancelConfirm: Cancel the pending digital signature registration?
signature.revoked: Your previous digital signature was revoked
signature.expiredHint: Your certificate has expired, please register again
signature.forgotPin: Forgot your PIN: it cannot be recovered (the system does not store it). Ask an administrator to revoke your certificate, then register again.
